I work on computational social science, agent-based models, and interactive visualization at the [Institute for Analytical Sociology (IAS)](https://liu.se/en/research/computational-and-analytical-sociology), Linköping University.

This list is pulled from my Google Scholar profile and cached locally so it does not query Google on every site build. To update it, run `Rscript scripts/update_publications.R`. You can also check my [Google Scholar profile](https://scholar.google.com/citations?hl=en&user=TycFXMIAAAAJ){target="_blank"} directly or read my [CV](cv/cv_page.html).

[CS2Nordics (2026)]{.system-title}

::: system-content
### Venue-based Interventions in an Agent-Based Model of Residential Segregation

**V Suschevskiy**, B Jarvis (2026).  
Presented at the Nordic Conference on Computational Social Science (CS2Nordics 2026), Linköping, Sweden.

We look at how daily activity spaces (venues, amenities) interact with residential choices in agent-based models of segregation. Local interventions reshape micro and meso segregation patterns, but changing macro-level segregation dynamics requires systemic policy interventions.
